UserSettings.title: User Settings
UserSettings.description: Custom game settings including custom model IDs and theme preferences for the chess game.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns these settings.

gameName.description: Custom display title for the chess game.

pieceNames.description: Custom display names for each of the 6 chess piece types.

pieceWeapons.description: Custom weapon names for each of the 6 chess piece types.

pieceModelRefs.description: Mapping of PieceType to object containing reference IDs for dataUrl, mapUrl, normalMapUrl, roughnessMapUrl, metalnessMapUrl, and emissiveMapUrl.

pieceGlbUrls.description: Mapping of piece type and side keys to Cloudflare R2 .glb model URLs.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last saved.

FileMetadata.title: File Metadata
FileMetadata.description: Metadata for segmented large 3D model and texture files stored across chunk documents.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this file.

totalChunks.description: Total number of sequential chunks comprising the file (1 to 500).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when file upload was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when file metadata was last updated.

FileChunk.title: File Chunk
FileChunk.description: A single base64 chunk of raw data for a segmented 3D mesh or texture file.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns the parent file.

fileId.description: Document ID of the parent FileMetadata record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was written.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: The user's game settings and custom 3D model assignments (e.g. settingId = 'current').

/users/{userId}/files/{fileId}.description: Metadata for 3D model meshes and PBR texture map files uploaded by the user.

/users/{userId}/files/{fileId}/chunks/{c.description: Individual 450KB slices of a single 3D mesh or texture dataUrl.
